startScreen.name: Behind the Door
startScreen.goal: A sensual escape to help you slip into the mood, spark your imagination, and spend the evening purely for yourself.
startScreen.description:
Women Voice, Her+Him.

This night, she wears her best dress to remind herself who she really is. Random bar, just one drink, then back home, she tells herself. But the glance she catches on her makes her forget everything. A labyrinth of words with this handsome stranger ends with him asking permission to go further, deeper. She’s been craving this for years, and at some point she can’t resist him anymore. She keeps saying yes until the door behind them shuts and there are no more questions left.

startScreen.name: Passionate Tango
startScreen.goal: A sensual escape to help you slip into the mood, spark your imagination, and spend the evening purely for yourself.
startScreen.description:
Woman Voice, Her+Him.

She books a private tango lesson because she needs a distraction, something that makes her feel alive again. She gets ready slowly, carefully chosen lingerie under her dress just for herself, like a small secret. But the moment he takes her hands to dance, her body starts listening in a way her mind didn’t expect. Every step becomes a tease, every pause becomes a test, and his lead feels too steady to fight. She keeps following until the kiss stops feeling like a lesson and starts feeling like the moment she is truly alive again.
